document.title: Inventory 3.0 SDS Registry Rebuild and App Integration
document.headline: Rebuild the Inventory App SDS registry and integrate verification status into the current Inventory 3.0 interface

primaryProject.projectGoal: Maintain product, quantity, location, transaction-history, product-reference, and SDS information through a stable inventory application whose project identity is independent of release numbering.
primaryProject.projectPhase: SDS registry rebuild and app-integration planning
primaryProject.identificationBasis: The user explicitly designated Inventory App as the stable project name, the repository path is projects/inventory-app, and the current deployed application and plan still use the historical product name Inventory 3.0.

projectContext.relationshipSummary: Inventory App is the primary project. The current deployed product is still named Inventory 3.0. The Klinswork Chemical Product Catalog provides the detailed source records; the rebuilt SDS sheet will expose a smaller operational view to the application.

subject.mainFocus: SDS registry rebuild and application integration
subject.description: A bounded implementation plan for replacing the bootstrap SDS sheet with a status-aware current-and-history registry, correcting a small set of confirmed product references, and updating the client interface without changing inventory transaction behavior.

planContext.promptingNeed: The seven-row bootstrap SDS tab no longer represents the twelve-product catalog and cannot distinguish current document selection from verification quality, source conflicts, historical revisions, or known source unavailability.
planContext.planningScope: Rebuild and populate the SDS sheet; apply a narrow set of confirmed product-reference corrections; refactor client-side SDS selection and presentation; add status styling; run integrity, integration, regression, and deployment tests.
planContext.planningBasis: The assembled chemical product catalog, live Inventory App spreadsheet, current Apps Script deployment, supplied source files, and the Klinswork project-change documentation workflow.
assumptions: The project will use the stable name Inventory App even while the current deployed interface remains named Inventory 3.0.
The rebuilt sheet will remain named SDS.
The existing columns product_id, current, revision_date, source, date_verified, and document_url will be retained for compatibility.
DataService.gs will continue to read arbitrary nonblank, unique headers.
The chemical product catalog remains the detailed research authority.
The work session will be scheduled later and may occur after work or during the following weekend.
constraints: The implementation must not alter inventory quantities, events, transfer behavior, or rollback behavior.
The app must never silently select a historical SDS when no current row is marked.
Status and document availability must remain separate.
Genuine source conflicts must remain visible.
Date-only values should be stored as YYYY-MM-DD text to avoid timezone conversion.
The formal project registry and implementation-plan catalog do not yet exist.
outOfScope: Changing configured spreadsheet or sheet names
Storing complete SDS section text in Google Sheets

targetState.currentState: The SDS tab contains seven bootstrap rows, omits five products, uses current as its only state indicator, includes three superseded revisions as current records, and does not expose product match, coverage, issues, actions, source roles, or source-unavailable findings. The client can fall back to an arbitrary first row.
targetState.desiredState: The SDS tab contains one current operational record for CHEM-001 through CHEM-012 plus retained historical revisions; current and status are independent; exact SDS identity, source, coverage, issues, and actions are represented; and both client views use one integrity-aware selector.
targetState.successDefinition: All twelve products have exactly one current registry row, historical records remain noncurrent, representative status conditions render correctly, available documents remain openable, source-unavailable records are represented honestly, unrelated inventory behavior passes regression checks, and the updated canonical deployment is verified.
nonGoals: Replace the chemical catalog with the spreadsheet
targetState.transitionSummary: Move from a link-oriented bootstrap table to a controlled operational registry backed by the chemical catalog, then update the client selection and presentation layers without disturbing inventory operations.

implementationStages.title: Preserve the current state
implementationStages.description: Back up the current SDS tab, record its headers and rows, capture the deployed version and URL, and preserve representative screenshots.
exitCriteria: The current SDS data can be restored.

implementationStages.title: Build the new sheet structure
implementationStages.objective: Establish the approved headers, controls, and maintenance view.
implementationStages.description: Create the status-aware schema, date handling, dropdown validation, filters, grouped columns, conditional formatting, and duplicate-current checks.

implementationStages.title: Populate current and historical records
implementationStages.objective: Transfer catalog knowledge into the operational registry.
implementationStages.description: Create twelve current rows and historical rows for superseded CHEM-003, CHEM-005, and CHEM-007 revisions.
exitCriteria: Every product has exactly one current row.

implementationStages.title: Apply conclusive product corrections
implementationStages.objective: Correct only product-reference errors supported conclusively by the catalog.
implementationStages.description: Review and update selected Products rows while retaining genuine conflicts and prior identifiers where useful.
exitCriteria: Corrected values agree with catalog evidence.

implementationStages.title: Refactor SDS record selection
implementationStages.objective: Create one controlled client-side SDS selection path.
implementationStages.description: Add shared lookup helpers, case-insensitive matching, no-current handling, multiple-current handling, and remove the first-row fallback.
exitCriteria: Both client views resolve the same current record.

implementationStages.title: Update SDS presentation
implementationStages.objective: Display current record identity, status, coverage, issues, actions, and document availability.
implementationStages.description: Modify renderProductPage() and renderSdsAction() while retaining document access for partial and conflicting records.
exitCriteria: Available documents are not hidden by status.

implementationStages.title: Add status styling
implementationStages.objective: Make record condition readable and accessible.
implementationStages.description: Add text-supported visual treatments for verified, partial, conflicting, unavailable, and integrity-warning conditions.
exitCriteria: Meaning does not depend on color alone.

implementationStages.title: Update version and run regression checks
implementationStages.objective: Prepare a deployable revision and protect unrelated behavior.
implementationStages.description: Update CONFIG.APP_VERSION and verify location, browsing, quantity actions, product details, and SDS actions.
exitCriteria: No unrelated inventory regression is observed.

implementationStages.title: Deploy and verify
implementationStages.objective: Publish and validate the approved application revision.
implementationStages.description: Create a new Apps Script version, update the existing deployment, open the canonical /exec URL, and run the final test matrix.
exitCriteria: The canonical deployment serves the new version.

implementationStages.title: Declare the documentation checkpoint
implementationStages.objective: Bound the completed work and preserve evidence for downstream documentation.
implementationStages.description: Record actual times, classify results and deviations, preserve changed files and tests, and prepare the later summary and sidecar reconciliation.
exitCriteria: Evidence is sufficient for later summary and debrief.

plannedTests.name: Sheet structure loads
preconditions: At least one data row exists.
plannedTests.expectedResult: SDS rows load without blank-header or duplicate-header errors.
plannedTests.failureCondition: readTable() throws or required fields are absent.

plannedTests.name: One current row per product
preconditions: Current and historical rows are populated.
plannedTests.expectedResult: Every product has exactly one current row.
plannedTests.failureCondition: Any product has zero or more than one current row.

plannedTests.name: Verified record display
plannedTests.expectedResult: Verified status, SDS identity, complete coverage, and working document action display.
plannedTests.failureCondition: Any required field is missing or the document does not open.

plannedTests.name: Partially verified record display
plannedTests.expectedResult: Partial status and issue display without blocking the available document.
plannedTests.failureCondition: The app hides the document or omits the limitation.

plannedTests.name: Conflicting record with document
plannedTests.expectedResult: Conflict status and issue display while the SDS remains available.
plannedTests.failureCondition: Conflict is hidden or document access is removed.

plannedTests.name: Source unavailable record
preconditions: CHEM-008 current row exists without a document URL.
plannedTests.expectedResult: Known conflict and source-unavailable state display without an Open SDS button or 'No SDS record' message.
plannedTests.failureCondition: The app reports no record or shows a broken document action.

plannedTests.name: Historical revision not selected
preconditions: CHEM-003 current and historical rows exist.
steps: Compare selected row with current flag.
Inspect historical row in the sheet.
plannedTests.expectedResult: The current replacement displays and the historical row remains retained but unselected.
plannedTests.failureCondition: The historical row is displayed as current.

plannedTests.name: No current row integrity failure
preconditions: A temporary test copy is available.
steps: Remove the current flag for one product.
plannedTests.expectedResult: The app reports that records exist but none is current.
plannedTests.failureCondition: The app silently displays the first row.

plannedTests.name: Multiple current rows integrity failure
preconditions: A temporary test copy is available.
steps: Mark two rows current for one product.
plannedTests.expectedResult: The app reports a multiple-current integrity problem.
plannedTests.failureCondition: The app silently selects one row.

plannedTests.name: Relative and absolute document URLs
preconditions: At least one external and one repository-relative URL are present.
plannedTests.expectedResult: Both URL forms open through the existing resolver.
plannedTests.failureCondition: Either URL form produces an invalid target.

plannedTests.name: Product-page and action-panel consistency
plannedTests.expectedResult: Both views show the same current record, status, revision, and issue.
plannedTests.failureCondition: The views select or describe different rows.

plannedTests.name: Inventory regression
steps: Inspect opening, receive, use, correction, and transfer controls.
plannedTests.expectedResult: Existing inventory behavior remains available and no SDS change modifies quantities or event history.
plannedTests.failureCondition: Any unrelated inventory function is broken or changes data unexpectedly.

plannedTests.name: Canonical deployment verification
preconditions: A new Apps Script version has been deployed.
plannedTests.expectedResult: The canonical deployment serves the updated version and new SDS presentation.
plannedTests.failureCondition: The old version remains active or representative SDS views fail.

projectSpecificLessons: The stable project name should not include a release number; Inventory App can contain Inventory 3.0 and later versions.
The SDS sheet should be an operational projection of the detailed chemical catalog rather than a competing authority.
Current document selection and verification quality are separate dimensions.
Known absence should be represented by a record rather than by omission.
generalLessons: Bootstrap tables often remain useful longer when their original join fields are preserved during migration.
Historical records should be retained explicitly instead of overwritten.
Client fallback behavior can conceal data-integrity failures and should be replaced by visible error states.
A document sidecar should describe the authoritative human-readable plan rather than replace it.
